description: v11 filter impact analysis — which filters to keep/remove in live system

baseline_comparison.note: Phase 1 reproduced v10 configs with same params. Small numeric differences from portfolio dynamics.

symbol_blacklist_arb_op_pol.evidence: Removing ARB/OP/POL: BBS_1H_5M PF 6.21→7.13 (+15%), BBS_1H_15M PF 3.90→4.06 (+4%). Minimal trade count impact.

time_gate_utc_07_20.evidence: Kills 40-46% of trades with NO PF improvement. BBS_1H_5M: 116→63 trades, PF 7.13→5.90. KC: 73→44 trades, PF 5.17→3.74.

ltf_bar_confirmation_next_bar.evidence: Hurts next_bar strategies: BBS_1H_15M PF 4.06→3.57, KC 5.17→4.71. For pullback_ema21 (BBS_1H_5M) it helped (7.13→7.85) but that's a different entry mode.

break_even_sl_at_1_5r.evidence: Consistently hurts PF: BBS_1H_5M 7.13→6.59, KC 5.17→3.83. High WR strategies should ride to full TP.

sl_cooldown_4h_24h.evidence: No backtest effect (as expected for pullback strategies). Essential live safety mechanism preventing ARIA-style infinite re-entry after SL.

funding_rate_filter.evidence: Not testable in backtest (no historical funding data). Good risk management — blocks entries when funding > 0.05%/8h (extreme overcrowding).

vwap_filter_bbs_1h_5m.evidence: Phase 3: VWAP filter 116→111 trades, PF 7.13→6.93 (-3%). Marginal negative effect.

summary: Symbol blacklist, SL cooldown, and funding rate filter KEPT. Time gate, break-even SL, and LTF bar confirmation REMOVED based on annual backtest evidence.

range_lgc_strategy.evidence: PF ~0.5-0.6 across all 26 param configs. 2000+ signals/year but all losing. Crypto is trending-dominant — range fade strategies don't work on this data.
